messages:
sanjay: FYI rolled NCCL -> 2.21 across eu-west staggered canary at 03:00 UTC. seeing sporadic hangs on 8xA100 pods, looks like collectives never finish for some jobs. :warning:
Marta: which clusters/instance types? any pattern on kernel/driver?
Taylor: seeing it on pod group 'gpu-heavy-8' in eu-west-2 and one noisy instance in eu-west-1a. drivers are 535.86 on all affected hosts.
Olivia: got a reproducer? small repro that stalls quickly would help.
sanjay: yes, reproduced with our perf test: `python tests/allreduce_stress.py --gpus 8 --iters 100` — hangs at iteration 2-4 consistently. stack trace shows waiting in ncclCommInitRank / allreduce.
Marta: can you paste the NCCL debug logs? try `export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` and re-run. also check `dmesg` for PRI errors.
sanjay: pasted logs to the run: https://redwood.internal/runs/3762 (private). snippet: ```
[0] NCCL INFO Call to send/recv failed, socket closed, return -128
[0] NCCL WARN Allreduce step timed out after 120s
```
Taylor: that socket closed message smells like unexpected connection churn. are we seeing interface flaps? `ip link` or flexi NIC resets?
Olivia: checked host dmesg, saw intermittent mlx5_core resets on 3 hosts in the same AZ. vendor firmware kicked off a FW reclaim: `mlx5: Reset adapter on port 1`.
Marta: that could explain it. NCCL uses IB for collectives; fw resets lead to queue pair teardown and NCCL sees timeout. Did the NCCL upgrade change timeout/backoff behavior?
Taylor: changelog mentions improved connection detection and different handshake timing; might make it more sensitive to transient link resets.
sanjay: mitigation idea: set `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0` to force socket transport away from IB for now, or pin `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL`? not sure.
Olivia: forcing TCP will reduce perf but should avoid hangs. try `export NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eno1` on a canary. also `export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1` to disable IB transport entirely.
Marta: do it on a small canary and monitor perf / error rate. also roll back NCCL version on affected pools if TCP workaround fails.
Taylor: opened a rollback run in the deploy bot: `deploy-bot: rollback nccl 2.21 -> 2.19 on pool eu-west-gpu-heavy-8 at 04:10 UTC` (reaction :white_check_mark:).
deploy-bot: Started canary rollback on 3 nodes in eu-west-2a.
Olivia: also filed a vendor ticket with Mellanox/driver team — attaching NIC fw logs and dmesg: ticket #MLX-9927.
Marta: long-term: we need a pre-upgrade smoke that exercises transient IB resets: small allreduce with induced NIC reset to see behavior. add to upgrade checklist.
Taylor: agree. add steps: 1) run `allreduce_stress` with NCCL_DEBUG, 2) watch dmesg for mlx5 resets, 3) if any resets, abort rollout.
Olivia: cost note — several jobs blocked 20-60m each, autoscaler kept nodes up due to pods in CrashLoop or Pending because of hung containers. that's ~12 node-hours wasted in eu-west yesterday.
sanjay: created incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-03-15-nccl-euwest — will paste RCA when we have vendor response.
Taylor: for immediate: Canary TCP workaround deployed to one AZ, metrics look stable (throughput -40% but no hangs). planning full rollback in next 30m if no regressions.
Marta: thanks team. action items: @Olivia escalate with more logs, @Sanjay coordinate rollback and smoke tests, @Taylor update upgrade runbook with IB reset gate.
Olivia: on it.
tracebot: Traces collected for failing pods: trace@3762,3763,3769.
Marta: follow-up: let's schedule a cross-team postmortem with networking and infra. assign doc owner @sanjay. end.
